issues.issue: The consequence chain and most of the proposed verification tests target code that a finite_binding_probe row cannot reach. finiteLookupEstimate is only invoked when statisticsView == null (LmdbPackedCostModel.java L290-293: `mappedStatisticsSession || !context.prefixRelationsDescribeRows() ? null : finiteLookupEstimate(...)`). Every listed consequence requires an attached evidence state, which only LmdbFrontierStatisticsCostSession.attachState creates (L276-289), and that session is only constructed when mappedStatisticsReady() and the view is ready (openSession L149-175); otherwise PackedCostSession.scalar is used, whose detachEvidence returns an empty bundle (PackedCostSession.java L131-133). Hence evidenceSummary (LmdbFrontierStatisticsCostSession L367-371), certifiedRootRows (PackedCascadesPlanner L720-724 fed by PackedPlanRecipe.rootEvidenceSummary L166-171 which returns null without a bundle), PackedEvidenceStateRegistry L43-45 / PackedMemo L1095-1098 & L1117-1119 (require evidenceStateId != 0), EstimateContext.hasNoExecutions (EstimateContext.java L138-147 requires prefixEstimate.evidenceState()), LmdbMappedFrontierLearningSession L162/L440 (constructed only at LmdbFrontierStatisticsCostSession L64), PackedJoinEnumerator L10707-10715 (requires baseEvidenceStateId != 0) and LmdbHashJoinCosting L55 (Frontier domains) are all unreachable from a sampled finite probe. The severity escalation to 'effectively S2 ... certifies root rows, marks prefixes provably empty' is therefore not supported by the code. The bug is real but its effect is (a) explain text and (b) LmdbOperatorFeedbackStats treating plannedFrontierGuarantee=database_exact as immutable (L988-990, L1269-1271, L1963-1964).
issues.suggestion: Keep the label fix (it is correct and cheap) but restate the root cause/impact as S3: 'sampled finite probes are published as database_exact planned metrics, freezing LEO row learning for those operators and lying in explain output'. Replace the additionalTests that assert evidenceSummary zeroStatus, certifiedRootRows, PackedEvidenceStateRegistry classification and LmdbMappedFrontierLearningSession L162 behaviour (they would pass vacuously) with: (1) a packed-planner test over a frontier-OFF store asserting the installed StatementPattern node's plannedFrontierGuarantee != database_exact when the page estimator returns exact=false, and == database_exact when exact=true; (2) an LmdbOperatorFeedbackStats test showing a non-exact finite probe now admits row corrections.

issues.issue: Read-lock discipline is dropped for raw-handle reads that the design converts to 'explicit Txn parameter, no policy inside'. Today sampleTriplesStratified (TripleStore.java L1506, opens raw cursors on `txn`), indexCostProfile (L2157, mdb_stat on `txn`) and the page estimator (L1874) run inside TxnManager.doWith, which holds lockManager.readLock() around the callback (TxnManager.java L223-236). A commit resets/renews every tracked txn (Txn.reset L584-596 via txnManager.reset() at TripleStore L3413) and auto-grow deactivates them (setActive L604-616 via L3403-3404 activate) under the write lock; the read lock is what keeps the pinned handle stable while a cursor is open. The design only routes cardinalityUsingPageEstimator/legacy sampler through planningRead (locked) and leaves sampleTriplesStratified and indexCostProfile as Txn-taking methods with no lock, so a concurrent commit could mdb_txn_reset the pinned txn while a sampling cursor is positioned on it (use-after-reset). exactCardinality/repeatedVariableCardinality/boundedDistinctCursorSkipCardinality are fine because they go through getTriples -> LmdbRecordIterator, which locks and version-checks per next() (LmdbRecordIterator.java L145-159, L167-174, L186).
issues.suggestion: Make every raw-handle planner read a `planningRead(Transaction<T>)` callback (pinned -> run under lockManager.readLock() on pinned.get(); unpinned -> doWithPriority), i.e. sampleTriplesStratified and indexCostProfile keep their current doWith-style shape but call planningRead instead of txnManager.doWith. Only methods whose reads go through LmdbRecordIterator may take a bare Txn parameter. State this rule in the shared-infrastructure section so wp2/wp6 follow it for future 4.3 probes.

issues.issue: The 'closed-pin fallback' cannot be implemented as described. TripleStore's TxnManager runs in Mode.RESET (TripleStore.java L312), so Txn.close() does NOT zero the handle: release() parks the txn idle in txnPool with a live native transaction (TxnManager.java L640-655, `idle = true; offerPooled(this)`), and another thread may immediately recycle it via pollPooled()/reuse() (L175-190, L600-610). A stale pin therefore sees get() != 0 while the transaction belongs to someone else; the design's 'fall back when txn handle is 0' check only covers Mode.ABORT/close(). Txn exposes no closed/idle accessor (fields are private volatile, L541-548), so the fallback cannot even be expressed today.
issues.suggestion: Add a package-private `boolean Txn.isLive()` (owned && !closed && !idle, read under the Txn monitor) and have planningReadTxn/planningRead fall back when !isLive(). More importantly make the pin lifetime structurally nested: pin in LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline.optimize inside the same try/finally that owns the dataset, unpin before returning, and assert in LmdbSailDataset.close() that the thread's pin does not reference this txn (or clear it). Add the 'pin lifetime' test the design already lists, plus one where the dataset is closed by another thread mid-planning and the estimator returns Optional.empty()/fresh lease rather than reading a recycled txn.

issues.issue: Pinning the detached-refresh snapshot poisons the revision-keyed shared caches. LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh pins an UNTRACKED txn (LmdbSailStore.java L1489-1490 -> L3291-3292 createReadTxnUntracked), which keeps its pre-commit snapshot after a commit (Txn.reset L592-595 only sets stale=true). LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource reads tripleStore.getDataRevision() at call time and caches when the revision is unchanged afterwards (L265-283 estimateIds, L80-95 estimateExact, L135-150 estimateDistinctCursorSkip). If a commit lands between openDetachedPlanningSnapshot and the estimate call, the count computed on the OLD snapshot is stored in SHARED_CARDINALITY_CACHE / SHARED_EXACT_CARDINALITY_CACHE / SHARED_DISTINCT_CARDINALITY_CACHE under the NEW revision and served to every other query (as exact, in the exact cache) until the next commit. The refresh's own guards (LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh.java L92-95 and L133-135) abort the refresh but do not undo those writes. Today this cannot happen because tracked txns are renewed before dataRevision increments (TripleStore L3413-3415). LmdbExactFiniteSurfaceCache is safe (it re-checks currentRevision against the scope-open revision, L109/L157).
issues.suggestion: Either do not pin untracked snapshots (let LmdbDetachedPlanRefresh keep today's unpinned priority fallback; it runs on a background thread that holds no dataset lease, so starvation does not apply), or record `pinnedIsTracked` in the pin and suppress shared-cache writes when it is false, or key the shared caches on the txn's mdb_txn_id (LmdbFrontierSnapshotSource.snapshotEpochAndVersion L90-104 already reads it) instead of dataRevision. Add a test: open detached snapshot, commit rows, run a pinned estimate, assert SHARED_EXACT_CARDINALITY_CACHE does not serve the pre-commit count to a fresh query.

issues.issue: The end-to-end repro methods do not necessarily exercise the sites the design attributes to them, and no surefire report is available to check which of the five methods were red (only the aggregate 'tests=17, failures=11' in initial-evidence.review-f8.txt; .mvnf/workspaces/review-f8 reports are gone). On a default store FRONTIER_ESTIMATOR_MODE is AUTHORITATIVE (config/LmdbStoreConfig.java L79, L150), and in that mode LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.packedStatementPatternRows returns pointRows or NaN and never reaches legacyPackedRows (L92-108), LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactCandidate requires statistics == null (L269-271) and its storage-summary candidate too (L162). So `repeatedVarQueryWithOnlyDatasetSlotsFree` (`?s :p ?s`) most likely never calls repeatedVariableCardinality in the default configuration; whatever stall it shows comes from other sites (finite surface estimator L369, filter sampler, indexCostProfile). The design's reproTestMethods and the 3.10.1b repro attribution ('the repeated-variable estimate is the nested read') are therefore unverified.
issues.suggestion: When porting to LmdbPlannerReaderLeaseTest, run each end-to-end case twice (LmdbStoreConfig.setFrontierEstimatorMode(OFF) and default) and add a TxnManager package-private probe (ordinary/priority permits acquired during optimize) so each test asserts the specific site took zero nested permits, rather than relying on wall-clock < 8 s. Add direct TripleStore-level tests per converted method (pin present, both semaphores drained by other holders, call completes).

issues.issue: estimateExact with a repeated mask also routes to repeatedVariableCardinality and caches the result in SHARED_EXACT_CARDINALITY_CACHE as exact (LmdbStatementPatternCardinalitySource.java L83-93, L98-100). The design only says the capped repeatedVariableCardinality returns a non-exact extrapolation and that exactCardinality's cap yields OptionalDouble.empty()/-1; it does not say what estimateExact does with a non-exact PlanningCardinality from the repeated branch. If it returns the extrapolated rows, LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactCandidate (L269-281) publishes them with confidence 1.0/exact=true and Kind.EXACT_STORAGE (frontier-OFF stores), i.e. a mislabelled exact fact. Example: 10 000 `:sN :p :sN` rows plus 10 000 `:sN :p :oN`, cap 4096, query `SELECT * { ?s :p ?s }`: an index-order-biased extrapolation becomes an 'exact' candidate.
issues.suggestion: In estimateExact, when the PlanningCardinality is not exact return -1 (unavailable) and do not write SHARED_EXACT_CARDINALITY_CACHE; only the planning route (estimateForPlanning(..., mask) L233 -> estimateRepeatedIds) may consume the extrapolation, tagged non-exact. Add the corresponding assertion to the '>cap rows -> exactCandidate empty' test for the repeated-mask case.

issues.issue: The exactness the design will propagate is exact over BOTH planes regardless of the query's includeInferred: cardinalityUsingPageEstimator sums explicit + inferred DBs (TripleStore.java L1877-1881, L1895-1905), exactCardinality iterates both planes (L2109-2114), and only the frontier probe honours mayHaveInferred() via planeMask (LmdbEstimatorStorageAccess.java L94-96). For an explicit-only query on a store that has inferred rows, a probe labelled DATABASE_EXACT is an over-count (e.g. data: `:a :p 1` explicit, `:a :p 2` inferred; query includeInferred=false `VALUES ?s {:a} ?s :p ?o` -> exact=2 while the query yields 1). Not a false zero, but it contradicts the stated goal of an honest exact label and would re-enter the PackedJoinEnumerator/hash-join exact paths if a future mapped-session route ever consumes it.
issues.suggestion: Label DATABASE_EXACT only when the estimate is exact AND (mayHaveInferred() == false || the dataset includes inferred); otherwise CERTIFIED_BOUND_ONLY with upper = both-plane count. Apply the same rule to the zero-escalation boundedExactCardinality (count the explicit plane separately so a 0 on explicit-only queries is still provable).

issues.issue: File/line anchors in sail-base are off: the design says to add the unwrap override in SailDatasetImpl 'near the getSnapshotEpoch override', but SailDatasetImpl has no getSnapshotEpoch override (grep of core/sail/base/.../SailDatasetImpl.java finds only `derivedFrom` at L56/L70-71, no getSnapshotEpoch). It also does not state that pinning `derivedFrom`'s txn for an active-transaction query (branch() L1155-1163 -> DelegatingSailSource -> SailDatasetImpl overlay) means planner-time storage reads ignore the uncommitted Changeset — which is today's behaviour, but should be explicit since 3.3/3.7 (rollback leak) reviewers care about dirty-txn planning.
issues.suggestion: Point the SailDatasetImpl change at the class body (add both the unwrap override and a comment that the pin is the committed base snapshot only). Note in the design that UnionSailSource(inferred, explicit) makes dataset1 the INFERRED LmdbSailDataset, so 'unwrap dataset1 then dataset2' pins the inferred dataset's txn (harmless: same env, both DBs visible) — say so rather than 'pin the explicit dataset'.

issues.issue: planningReadTxn()'s unpinned fallback is specified as an ordinary createReadTxn on the assumption that 'the thread holds no dataset lease in that case'. That is only true if every planner entry point pins. Entry points that bypass LmdbQueryOptimizerPipeline (LmdbEvaluationStatistics.beginQueryOptimizationScope L223-225 used by other optimizers/tests, LmdbEstimatorRuntime.exact*Surface with scope == null L190-238, LmdbFilterPassSelection L47 from LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence L437) will still nest ordinary leases whenever a caller already holds a dataset txn, so the starvation mode is reduced, not eliminated.
issues.suggestion: Either pin in LmdbEvaluationStatistics.beginQueryOptimizationScope as well (resolve the txn from the TripleSource it is given, when available) or make the unpinned fallback for SHORT bounded callbacks use doWithPriority (as develop does) and log/count nested ordinary acquisitions in TxnManager (owner-thread tag) so the remaining sites can be found by the new tests.

missedFindings: Review 3.10 asks to 'cap the repeatedVariableCardinality/exactCardinality scans'; the design caps them but leaves LmdbFilterSelectivityStats.exactBoundedFilterZero (L685, bounded by maxScannedRows) and exactMatchingDistinctValues (L777, distinct-cursor-skip walk bounded only by the caller's 4_096 cap) as lease-holding scans without stating their bound in the shared-infrastructure contract; both are reached from LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence L308/L410/L467 at planning time.

The union-dataset double lease (two LmdbSailDatasets per includeInferred query, LmdbSailStore L3291) is the multiplier that makes ~63 queries saturate the pool; the design lists it only as an open question. Even a note that explicit+inferred datasets could share one txn (same env, both DBs) would halve lease pressure and is the only change that also helps execution-time starvation, which the pin does not address.

No mention that LmdbFrontierSnapshotSource.openPinnedTxn (L385-388) and LmdbSailDataset(untracked) also consume ordinary permits; they are background/refresh users, but the design's pool-accounting story ('strictly reduces permit usage') should list them so the new lease-count test knows the baseline.
semanticRegressionRisks: Detached refresh + untracked pin + shared caches (frontier-OFF stores): dataset {:a :p :b} committed; detached refresh opens snapshot; commit adds {:a :p :c}; refresh's pinned estimate caches exactCardinality(:a,:p,*,*)=1 under the new revision; a later query `SELECT * { :a :p ?o }` gets an exact=true candidate of 1 (LmdbStorageEstimatorEvidence.exactCandidate L269-281) — wrong exact facts feeding 3.3-style certificates until the next commit. Fix by not pinning untracked snapshots or suppressing shared-cache writes for them.

Use-after-reset if sampleTriplesStratified/indexCostProfile are converted to bare-Txn methods without the read lock: query `SELECT * { ?s :p ?o . ?s :q ?n FILTER(?n > 150) }` planning while another connection commits — mdb_txn_reset on the pinned txn under an open sampling cursor (TripleStore L1506+, TxnManager.Txn.resetNative L635-641). Native crash/garbage, not a wrong answer, but it is a regression introduced by the fix.

Explicit-only query over a store with inferred rows: `VALUES ?s {:a} ?s :p ?o` with includeInferred=false where :a :p has 1 explicit and 1 inferred row — the design would label the probe DATABASE_EXACT with rows=2; plan cost is off by the inferred plane and the label is false. No result change, but it undermines the 'honest exactness' goal.

3.10.1b changes exactCandidate availability for repeated-variable patterns over >4096 rows in frontier-OFF stores (`?s :p ?s` over a large :p) from exact count to unavailable/extrapolated; plan shape may change (loss of a sound but expensive optimisation). Acceptable if the repeated-mask branch of estimateExact returns -1 rather than an extrapolation (see minor issue).

Zero escalation must count with the same context semantics as getTriples: FiniteLookupKey graph==null maps to context -1 (all contexts); if boundedExactCardinality instead used context 0 (default graph) a `VALUES ?s {:a} ?s :p ?o` probe against data stored only in a named graph would be certified EXACT_ZERO while the store-default dataset query returns rows. Reuse getBestIndex/createMatcher exactly as sampleTriplesStratified does (L1500-1520).
